MINERAL REFERENCE — COAL

Sparse compressed carbonaceous seams, dull charcoal grains and fractured mineral edges; no scattered decorative spots.

Create only the mineral formations and their immediate contact details as a standalone design reference. The completed mcl_deepslate_deepslate.png texture is supplied separately for final composition and must remain unchanged outside mineral-occupied areas.
